title: Recurring theft-flagged props (coin-dish, tongs, candles, tithe-scales, iron-sun pendant) appear in nearly every shop/chapel/forge, explicitly called out and 'watched,' but none connect to any quest, dialogue, or consequence beyond a single flavor line if declined -- they read as deliberate hooks but are dead ends, which is misleading about what the game is signaling as worth pursuing.
where: The Last Light Inn / The Forge / Gray Chapel / The Chandler's Counter / The Ironbound Chapterhouse
